### Bio:

I am a PhD candidate in the Department of Biostatistics at UCLA, working with Dr. Donatello Telesca. My current research involves developing Bayesian methods for transfer learning in high-dimensional regression. I previously completed my BS in Statistics at UC Davis. In my free time, I like playing sports (particularly soccer and volleyball), and eating out at unique restaurants with my friends.
